## Wikimedia Foundation - Senior Software Engineer, Core Experiences – Contract

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/wikimedia/jobs/8223864)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior full-stack engineer building Wikipedia web experiences, REST APIs, and reusable app integrations. Supporting Wikimedia’s global free-knowledge mission through accessible, scalable product features.
Full-stack engineer building Wikipedia web experiences, APIs, and app integrations for Wikimedia
- Salary: $56 - $87 per hour
- Tech stack: JavaScript, PHP, TypeScript, Vue.js
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Deliver medium-complexity initiatives from technical discovery through delivery
- Break down initiatives into features, drive estimation, manage scope, identify risks, and support pragmatic tradeoffs
- Create mobile Wikipedia product experiences for global, multilingual audiences across web and app surfaces
- Design and build accessible, adaptable, scalable, and reusable frontend components
- Create and maintain RESTful APIs, schemas, contracts, monitoring, and scalable data pipelines
- Build software that is testable, observable, and debuggable
- Instrument features for deeper analysis by Product Analysts
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, analysts, and native app engineers
- Bachelor's degree and 5-10+ years of related professional experience, with significant experience building production web applications and services
- Strong professional experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js, and backend languages such as PHP
- Experience building responsive or mobile-first web experiences, with attention to performance, accessibility, and usability
- Experience designing and integrating with server-side APIs
- Experience delivering in a self-driven, lean environment
- Commitment to the Foundation's Mission and Values
- Applicants outside the US must have current work authorization in their location

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior full-stack engineer building Wikipedia web experiences, REST APIs, and reusable app integrations. Supporting Wikimedia’s global free-knowledge mission through accessible, scalable product features.
Full-stack engineer building Wikipedia web experiences, APIs, and app integrations for Wikimedia
Role description:
• Deliver medium-complexity initiatives from technical discovery through delivery
• Break down initiatives into features, drive estimation, manage scope, identify risks, and support pragmatic tradeoffs
• Create mobile Wikipedia product experiences for global, multilingual audiences across web and app surfaces
• Design and build accessible, adaptable, scalable, and reusable frontend components
• Create and maintain RESTful APIs, schemas, contracts, monitoring, and scalable data pipelines
• Build software that is testable, observable, and debuggable
• Instrument features for deeper analysis by Product Analysts
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, analysts, and native app engineers
• Identify technical opportunities and risks, clarify priorities and sequencing, and align teams on outcomes and capacity
• Follow standards for code review, technical design, testing, documentation, accessibility, observability, and decision-making
• Plan work with awareness of downstream and upstream effects
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree and 5-10+ years of related professional experience, with significant experience building production web applications and services
• Strong professional experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js, and backend languages such as PHP
• Experience building responsive or mobile-first web experiences, with attention to performance, accessibility, and usability
• Experience designing and integrating with server-side APIs
• Experience delivering in a self-driven, lean environment
• Commitment to the Foundation's Mission and Values
• Applicants outside the US must have current work authorization in their location
Benefits:
• Fully remote work
• Flexible location-based pay adjusted to country of hire
• Equal opportunity and inclusive workplace
• Accommodation assistance during the application process
• Employment through a local third-party Employer of Record for non-US employees
Tech stack:
JavaScript, PHP, TypeScript, Vue.js
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
